title: Canvas
subtitle: Draw, sketch, and diagram with Excalidraw

empty.title: No canvases yet
empty.description: Create your first canvas to start sketching ideas, diagrams, and flows. Your work is saved locally to this device.

rename.label: Canvas name
rename.placeholder: Enter a name for this canvas

delete.confirm: Delete "{{name}}"? This action cannot be undone.
delete.confirmGeneric: Delete this canvas? This action cannot be undone.

import.description: Select an .excalidraw file to import as a new canvas.

export.downloadDesktopOnly: File export is available in the desktop app only

errors.loadFailedDescription: Something went wrong while loading this canvas. Try reopening it from the list.
errors.saveFailedDescription: Your changes could not be saved. Please try again.
errors.clipboardFailed: Could not copy image to clipboard
errors.clipboardUnsupported: Clipboard image copy is not supported in this environment
errors.importParseError: That file is not a valid Excalidraw canvas
errors.importReadError: Failed to read the selected file
errors.canvasNotFoundDescription: This canvas no longer exists, or the link is invalid. It may have been deleted from another window.
errors.boundaryTitle: Something went wrong with this canvas
errors.boundaryDescription: An unexpected error stopped the canvas from rendering. Your saved data is safe — try again or head back to your library.

canvasList.label: List canvases
canvasList.description: Lists all canvases in your local library, returning each canvas's id, name, last-modified time, and element count. Read-only and does not modify any canvas.

canvasCreate.label: Create canvas
canvasCreate.description: Creates a new canvas with the provided name and optional initial Excalidraw scene. Returns the new canvas id. Requires your approval before running.
canvasCreate.approvalDetail: The assistant wants to create a new canvas named "{{name}}".

canvasRead.label: Read canvas
canvasRead.description: Reads the Excalidraw scene (elements and app state) of the canvas with the given id. Read-only.

canvasUpdate.label: Update canvas
canvasUpdate.description: Replaces or patches the Excalidraw scene of an existing canvas. Requires your approval before running.
canvasUpdate.approvalDetail: The assistant wants to update canvas "{{name}}".

canvasDelete.label: Delete canvas
canvasDelete.description: Permanently deletes the canvas with the given id. Requires your approval before running.
canvasDelete.approvalDetail: The assistant wants to delete canvas "{{name}}". This action cannot be undone.

unsavedDialog.title: Unsaved changes
unsavedDialog.description: You have unsaved changes on this canvas. Save before leaving?
